scope: Static graph arithmetic and reaggregation of existing profiles; no new inference or timing. Logical activation bytes are not measured DRAM traffic.
stage_definition: Output temporal-rate domain; charge upsampling matrices and phase finish to the destination stage.

arithmetic.fused_matmul_note: The two optimized FusedMatMul records are source linear2 MatMul -> layer_scale_2 Mul. Source ops have no transpose attributes, original weights are [2048,512], profile input [1,1360,2048] and output [1,1360,512]. Their required source contraction is unambiguously K=2048. Saved trace does not serialize optimized FusedMatMul transA/transB flags and no optimized Mimi graph is present; those flags have not been directly inspected. Counts are for source mathematical products and do not assume optimized physical transpose flags.
caveats: Dense MAC estimate, not measured instructions or CPU performance.
Bias, activations including Snake, ELU, GELU/tanh, softmax, normalization, masks, resampling, scalar scales, copying and layout work excluded.
Mimi attention is full dense T-by-T in this exported whole-call graph; source masks do not reduce the counted multiplication.
ConvTranspose counts input elements times full stored kernel and output channels per group; includes boundary work whose output is subsequently sliced.
Padded ordinary/depthwise convolution counts zero-valued boundary taps conventionally; a boundary-specialized kernel may skip them.
The 2.342x ratio applies at 6.8 seconds; Mimi attention makes it duration-dependent and unsuitable as a fixed streaming ratio.

fusion_estimates.overlap_note: The complete matmul epilogue includes the ordered Add fusion saving; full-stage tiling overlaps both. These are logical read/write counts, not RTF forecasts.
